name: aiteacher
description: Root orchestrator. The Next.js app lives in web/, the agent + knowledge service in teacher/, the reference writer engine in mathwriter/. See ARCHITECTURE_V2.md.

scripts.teacher:install: uv venv --python 3.12 teacher/.venv && uv pip install --python teacher/.venv/bin/python -e teacher[dev]
scripts.writer:install: python3 -m venv mathwriter/.venv && mathwriter/.venv/bin/pip install -r mathwriter/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:fsrs && npm run test:mastery && npm run test:retrieval && npm run test:teach && npm run test:writer && npm run test:visual && npm run test:teacher
